a70d405dd06b041a4b9c6849a6233862b95ca807

Upstream: https://github.com/ROCm/rocm-libraries
Branch:   develop
Path:     shared/origami

external/origami is a vendored snapshot of the directory above. Origami lives
in a subdirectory of the rocm-libraries monorepo, so it is copied in rather
than imported with `git subtree` the way external/triton and
external/llvm-project are. Re-vendor by checking out the commit recorded here
(or a newer one), copying shared/origami over external/origami, and updating
the hash above:

    TEMP_DIR=$(mktemp -d)
    git clone --no-checkout --filter=blob:none --sparse --depth 1 -b develop \
      https://github.com/ROCm/rocm-libraries.git "$TEMP_DIR"
    git -C "$TEMP_DIR" sparse-checkout set shared/origami
    git -C "$TEMP_DIR" checkout develop
    git -C "$TEMP_DIR" rev-parse HEAD
    cp -a "$TEMP_DIR"/shared/origami/. external/origami/
    rm -rf "$TEMP_DIR"

That copy overwrites the tree with clean upstream, dropping the downstream
changes recorded in origami-patches/. Re-apply the survivors afterwards:

    for p in ../../origami-patches/*.patch; do
      (cd external/origami && patch -p1 < "$p")
    done

See origami-patches/origami-patch-content.txt for what each one is for and
when to drop it.
